subject: Mahindra Scorpio-N
_angle: Option 1 — Tank with a brain (rugged + tech)

segments.text: Mahindra gave a body-on-frame tank 203 horsepower — then taught it to brake for you. A tank with a brain?!
The diesel four-by-four makes 400 Newton-metres — enough to bully a speed breaker into apologising.
It starts near thirteen-and-a-half lakh; the top one adds a twelve-speaker Sony — your whole street hears it.
Tough, loaded, smart, cheaper than you'd guess — the overachiever cousin at every family wedding. Hit like if you'd buy it.

pops.anchor: Hit like if you'd buy it

segments.text: Scorpio-N or Fortuner — who wins the driveway? Comment 1 or 2. Like, share, subscribe. A tank with a brain?
